about: La Prairie is a South Shore city in Montérégie, on the St. Lawrence immediately south of Montréal near the Champlain Bridge approaches. It preserves a historic Vieux-La Prairie village on the river while newer suburbs extend inland toward Autoroute 30. Commuter rail and highway links tie it tightly to Montréal. About 26,000 people live in La Prairie.
seoSummary: South Shore city with a historic riverfront village facing Montréal across the St. Lawrence.
knownFor: Mix of heritage core and inland suburbs
